user.title: Nooie
user.description: Point at the Nooie add-on's go2rtc server. On Home Assistant OS and Supervised installs this is http://nooie:1984; on HA Container with port mapping it is http://127.0.0.1:1984.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the go2rtc server at that URL.
error.no_streams: Reached the server, but found no Nooie streams. Configure the Nooie add-on with your cameras first.
